note: Submodule of graphql_compose. Extends the Image type with a variations() field returning image-style derivatives. Enabling an image style (entity_config.image_style.<style>.enabled) adds it to the ImageStyleAvailable enum. Medium/hard cases are grounded in entity_config.image_style.thumbnail.enabled (baseline: absent). Evals avoid live GraphQL queries and 'drush cr'.

evals.prompt: What does graphql_compose_image_style add to the GraphQL Compose schema?
evals.expected_output: It extends the Image type with a variations(styles: [ImageStyleAvailable]) field that returns image-style derivatives (url/width/height) for the styles you expose.

evals.prompt: In graphql_compose_image_style, how do you make a Drupal image style (e.g. thumbnail) available to query as a variation?
evals.expected_output: Set entity_config.image_style.thumbnail.enabled = true in graphql_compose.settings.graphql_compose_server; enabling the style adds it to the ImageStyleAvailable enum.

evals.prompt: Which GraphQL types and data producer does graphql_compose_image_style provide to resolve image derivatives?
evals.expected_output: SchemaTypes ImageStyleAvailable (enum of enabled styles) and ImageStyleDerivative (url/width/height); the ImageDerivatives DataProducer resolves the requested derivatives via the ImageStyleSchemaExtension.

evals.prompt: On this site, one Drupal image style has been exposed in GraphQL Compose. Inspect the config and name the image style that is enabled.

Using graphql_compose_image_style, expose the 'thumbnail' image style in the GraphQL schema on the default GraphQL Compose server so it can be requested as an image variation. Apply the change to the live configuration.
